title: Kurdish Pack
description: ​A performance-focused PvP resource pack designed for clarity and smoothness. Features optimized textures for Mace and Crystal PvP tiers to provide a clean, distraction-free combat experience.
body:
A clean and focused PvP texture pack built to enhance your combat experience without unnecessary clutter. The visuals are designed to improve clarity in fights, helping you stay aware and react faster.
This pack places special emphasis on mace PvP and crystal PvP, with textures tailored to make these playstyles more intuitive and visually clear. All other kits and items are also styled to match, creating a consistent and smooth look across the game.
Optimized with simplicity in mind, the pack may also provide better performance on some devices, depending on your settings.
